Total body mass by species (grams, 50 rows used): Adelie 77,000; Chinstrap 53,225; Gentoo 77,600.

No rule formula defines the correct value, so I did not guess — I proposed and got approval to exclude those 3 rows. They are therefore not in the totals.
- species: no label variants or misspellings; all values are allowed labels. No duplicate rows.
- Not used by this question, so left untouched: flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values (-192, -198, -188) that break the 170–235 rule, and sex has 2 missing values plus 2 whitespace variants ("male ", " male"). These do not affect the species totals but should be fixed before any flipper-length or sex-based analysis.

Caveat: the three excluded penguins are missing from the per-species sums; if their true masses can be recovered (likely 5050, 5050, 4050 g), the totals would rise accordingly.
